notes.title: v1.6 Improvements
notes.content:
22 April - 5 May 2020

These weeks I have begun experimenting with new graphics and that has taken most of my time. There are some other small updates too:
Improved spell ambient sound effects. Listen to it fly past your ears!
Greatly improved settings menu
Fire spirits added to the wind dojo region
White robes issue fixed

Send feedback to support@fyngames.com

If you would like to join the Superior Wizards mailing list, send me a blank email with the subject "Join" to the address above.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.5 - Introducing the WIND spell
notes.content:
21 April 2020

Wind spell overhauled!
Wind dojo added! Search the world to find it!
Casting history now displayed at top of screen
Shifted areas to make the world more open and explorable on foot
Removed some city boundaries to allow more free exploration
Made the dungeon boss more dangerous

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.3 - Main Quest
notes.content:
18 - 24 March 2020

v1.3:
+Added a main quest with several new environments to explore
+Added a hidden achievement in the Monastery Temple area, see if you can get it.
+Added new characters
+New spell upgrade!
+Rewrote and expanded existing dialogues
+Added PS4 Controller support!
+Added a new obstacle course
+Improved the dungeon in Volcanic city
+Casting water into the train's engine now causes it to cool down rapidly
+Fixed clipping issues
+Fixed camera out of bounds issue
+Fixed issue where water spell upgrade did no damage

Will be launching a Kickstarter in April. The idea is to redesign the graphics.

Have you found a bug or want to give feedback? 
Join my discord channel: https://discordapp.com/invite/xF7DqGh
Your support helps me improve the game.

notes.title: New rooms
notes.content:
In this update there are two new rooms, one with a big hole and a new kind of enemy, and the other with 3 enemies all together. Be careful!

In the next update there will be two more new rooms with another puzzle and a tough enemy.

Feedback is always welcome.

- Joel

notes.title: Update - More dungeon rooms
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]

In this update we have two new dungeon rooms. In the first room there is a puzzle which you must solve to open the locked door. In the next room is a new kind of enemy and a trap. Try to defeat the enemy and be wary of where you step!

In the next update there will be two new rooms with two new enemies and several more obstacles to overcome.

There is still a lot more content to come and I will be posting updates every day. Don't forget to send me feedback at gabrielajzen@gmail.com!

Thanks for playing
- Joel

notes.title: What's in the new update?
notes.content:
-fixed AI bug: opponents are now more dangerous
-improved paths graphics
-improved rock graphics
-improved first obstacle course
-added small ice area
-made fire witch bernadette battle more interesting
-made water wizard leon's battle arena more interesting
-updates to avatars
-new characters - I am currently working on new quests for these characters
-you can now cast down without hitting yourself!
-you can open the spellbook from pause menu

Future plans and features:
*Smarter enemies with new spells and fighting strategies
*New enemies that require certain strategies and knowledge of certain spells to defeat
*New areas/biomes and arenas
*Improved graphics
*New quests
*Minimap
*Save points

Other ideas:
*Day/night cycle. Find a safe place to sleep or risk getting attacked
